visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair stands outdoors against a background of pink cherry blossoms, wearing a teal knitted cardigan and a white turtleneck. She points to her chin area with her index finger, looking into the camera with a concerned expression. (2) The scene shifts indoors to a brightly lit room; the woman wears a black sports bra and jeans, pinching the soft skin/fat near her armpit and upper arm to demonstrate a physical concern. (3) A close-up shows a man's jawline being pinched by fingers, highlighting sagging skin, followed by a split-screen comparison of the man and woman smiling. (4) The woman enters an aesthetic clinic with celebratory Dior balloons and floral arrangements; she views the medical treatment rooms which are clean and minimalist with white curtains and beige bedding. (5) A technical close-up of a large black medical machine labeled 'ONDA PRO' is shown, featuring a digital screen and various applicator handles. (6) The woman lies on a treatment bed while a male doctor in a white coat applies a handheld device to her cheek; her face appears slightly flushed. (7) Comparison shots show the woman's arm before and after the treatment, followed by side-profile shots of her jawline, which appears more defined. (8) The video concludes with the woman speaking directly to the camera in a room, and a final shot of her and the man talking to the doctor in a consultation office.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female narration begins over a bright, rhythmic electronic pop BGM. A 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies the first visual transition. (2) Narration continues with a fast tempo, explaining physical insecurities; a subtle 'pop' sound effect occurs during a variety text appearance. (3) The female voice transitions into a slightly lower register while introducing the clinic, maintaining high clarity. The BGM remains consistent in the background. (4) The male doctor's voice is heard briefly, offering professional assessment with a calm, neutral tone. (5) Short, sharp 'ding' and 'pop' sound effects are used to punctuate the display of the ONDA PRO machine's name and features. (6) Laughter and enthusiastic banter between the female narrator and her partner are heard during the result reveal phase, with the BGM swelling slightly in volume. (7) The video concludes with a summary narration and a call to action, ending on a final chord from the background music.
